guidance.question: How does management plan to achieve the ambitious revenue growth targets given the current performance?
guidance.answer: Titan plans to achieve ambitious revenue growth by focusing on buyer growth as a top priority (G1). They are targeting a top line growth of 18% to 20% for FY27 (G10) and expect to maintain buyer growth at 15% to 20% annually over the next three to five years (G12). Additionally, they anticipate gains from customs duty to positively impact their financials in the coming quarters (G9).

verdict.headline: Titan's revenue growth is lagging behind its ambitious targets for FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's narrative of achieving 18% to 20% revenue growth in FY27 is not supported by the reported numbers. The actual revenue growth for the latest quarter was only 10.1% year on year.
